title: 第14章 逆天（求追读！）
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一个画功很好，却丑得惊天动地的葫芦娃就这样出现在贺舟眼前。

贺舟原本还觉得学校里凉飕飕的，正在有危机感的时候，看到这个葫芦娃，忍不住蚌埠住笑出了声。

这个漫画作者虽然剧情垃圾了点，但是画风还挺逗。

这么简单的一个浓缩了之后不到六话就能讲完的小漫画，哪里需要这种画风啊。

这就跟自己上辈子看的沙雕小漫画似的，用游戏CG的风格画一个沙雕漫，反而没那个味道了。

这个作者似乎不信邪。

把封面上的紫色葫芦娃也画了一个改良版出来。

【田小西：那飘带就代表了这个小仙童的法力！他周围萦绕着灵气！衣服也是天界仙童穿的服饰！

我经过了设计！连衣服的花纹和袖子的花纹都那么闪耀！这个纹路是仙鹤宝葫芦纹，是我精心设计的…图/】

底下的漫画粉丝在看到的时候，全部都是吐槽的。

【我的眼睛！放弃吧！还是这个蜡笔版的更好看！我现在已经把蜡笔版的看顺眼了，觉得很好看！】

【不准画了！不准改贺舟的蜡笔版了！】

【虽然画得很好，怎么感觉就是这么鬼畜…】

“哈哈哈哈！”

贺舟在课堂上直接笑喷了，声音大得旁边江黛迷迷糊糊被吵醒，不明所以一脸疑惑看过来，耳朵下意识的动了动。

巡视了一圈，在看到贺舟周围没有什么危险了之后，才从自己胸前的小布兜里掏出了贺舟给的肉干吃了几块。

那优哉游哉的表情，完全和周围阴郁的妖怪都市的环境格格不入。

两人各做各的事。

旁边的人不知道聊到了什么，忽然想到了江黛是从岛外转学过来的，于是忍不住叫她。

“江黛同学。”

“……”

小猫假装没听见。

“江黛同学！”

旁边人声音更大了点。

江黛趴在桌上吃肉干，皱起眉头，假装没听见。

但她表情里带着几丝警惕。

那模样活像像是警惕那边几个人要害贺舟似的，莫名其妙的警惕让贺舟忍不住哭笑不得。

旁边的同学见到江黛怎么也不回话也不理人，伸出手想拍她的肩膀：“我们其实是…”

手还没碰到她肩膀，就见到她反应极大的飞快的如同应激似的一个转身，靠过来贺舟这边，背对着贺舟，正面对着她们凶巴巴的‘哈’了一声。

“别碰我！！”

“哈！！”

那带着捕猎的竖瞳，耳朵都要竖起来的警觉模样，吓了那边的几个同学一跳。

她们立马摆摆手：“我们只是有几个问题。”

“哈！”

“我们不问了就是。”

看到她们怂了，江黛才带着几丝得意的扭头，像是保护了贺舟一样，又趴在旁边继续吃肉干。

人气值忽然增加。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A gourd baby with good painting skills but shockingly ugly appearance appeared in front of He Zhou.

He Zhou originally thought it was chilly in the school, but when he felt a sense of crisis, he couldn't help but laugh out loud when he saw the gourd boy.

Although the plot of this comic is a bit rubbish, the drawing style is quite funny.

There is no need for such a style of painting for such a simple comic that can be condensed and finished in less than six chapters.

This is just like the sand sculpture comics I read in my previous life. I drew a sand sculpture comic in the style of game CG, but it doesn't have the same flavor anymore.

This author does not seem to believe in evil.

I also drew an improved version of the purple gourd doll on the cover.

[Tian Xiaoxi: That ribbon represents the magic power of this little fairy boy!There is aura surrounding him!The clothes are also the clothes worn by fairy children in heaven!

I've been designed!Even the patterns on the clothes and sleeves are so sparkling!This pattern is the crane and gourd pattern, which I carefully designed...Picture/]

When the comic fans below saw it, they all complained.

【My eyes!Give up!This crayon version looks better!I now like the crayon version and think it looks great!】

【No more drawing allowed!Don’t change He Zhou’s crayon version!】

[Although the painting is very good, why does it feel so weird...]

"Hahahaha!"

He Zhou burst out laughing in class. His voice was so loud that Jiang Dai next to him was woken up in a daze. She looked over with a confused look on her face and her ears moved subconsciously.

After looking around for a while and seeing that there was no danger around He Zhou, he took out a few pieces of the jerky given by He Zhou from the small cloth pocket on his chest and ate a few pieces.

That carefree expression was completely incompatible with the surrounding gloomy monster city.

The two of them each do their own thing.

The people next to me didn't know what they were talking about. They suddenly thought that Jiang Dai had transferred from outside the island, so they couldn't help but call her.

"Classmate Jiang Dai."

"..."

The kitten pretended not to hear.

"Classmate Jiang Dai!"

The voice next to me was a little louder.

Jiang Dai lay on the table eating dried meat, frowning, pretending not to hear.

But there was a hint of caution in her expression.

It looked like he was wary of the people over there trying to harm He Zhou. The inexplicable vigilance made He Zhou unable to help but laugh or cry.

When the classmate next to her saw Jiang Dai not replying or paying attention, he reached out to pat her on the shoulder: "We are actually..."

Before his hand touched her shoulder, she saw her react extremely quickly and turned around as if she was in a hurry. She came over to He Zhou, with her back to He Zhou, and she let out a fierce 'ha' when she was facing them.

"Don't touch me!!"

"Ha!!"

His hunting eyes and alert look that made his ears stand up startled a few students over there.

They immediately waved their hands: "We just have a few questions."

"Ha!"

"We won't ask anymore."

Seeing that they were timid, Jiang Dai turned her head with a hint of pride, as if she was protecting He Zhou, and then lay down beside him and continued eating dried meat.

The popularity suddenly increased.
